action.description: start a scan of a granted folder, or step an existing one.

path.description: start: the directory inside the folder to scan (default: all of it).

exclude.description: start: gitignore-style patterns to leave out, relative to path.

include_tests.description: start: judge test files too (default false).

max_files.description: start: stop after this many files (default 5000).

scan_id.description: step: the scan to advance; start: an optional name for the new scan (letters, digits, _ and -).

max_calls.description: step: Jev calls this step may make (default 6).
